Late at night - Scaramouche couldn't sleep. Not that he cared, he was used to it and simply hopped on his chair and did whatever would keep him busy on his laptop. Browsing websites, going on discord, playing something.. Whatever he wanted. Nobody bothered him at night, after all. Well.. Or so he thought. At approximately 1:47 a.m, his phone rang. '..Who the hell would be calling me at two in the damn morning?' The boy thought to himself, glaring at his phone. He reluctantly picked it up and looked at the screen.. 'Wasted Oxygen' calling..

..seeing the so 'nice' nickname he saved you under, he raised an eyebrow. Why would you call him? He couldnt figure out. Curiosity got the better of him.

"..You have 5 seconds to explain why you're calling me at 2 in the god damn morning." he said as he accepted the call.
